fishing: WHEN: Fri Nov 6; residual wind easing, sheltered inshore/Lemon Bay best. PASSES-BEACH: redfish, whiting, pompano, sheepshead, flounder, Spanish mackerel near Englewood Beach / Manasota / Stump Pass on live shrimp, paddletails, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: redfish, snook, trout, flounder, sheepshead strong on docks, mangroves, oyster bars, flats. NEARSHORE: cobia, snapper, tripletail, bonita in 40-50 ft when calm enough. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless spoons, popping cork. Sources: Waterline Nov 5 (Fishin Franks/Economy Tackle: inshore reds/snook/trout/flounder/sheepshead, nearshore cobia/snapper), FL Sportsman SW recent (low water reds/snappers/trout/drum, abundant bait).
redtide: FWC status (next report due Nov 6; prior Oct 30): K. brevis not observed or background only in Southwest Florida past week (one Pinellas background). Bloom concentrations in NW FL Bay/Gulf counties. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Englewood Beach / Manasota Key / Palm Island GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples Oct 5-12). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2, Sarasota ~148 outages (minor/isolated); no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
